the Prophet.text: The Prophet (S) said: You will care excessively for (positions of) power. Then it will be an affliction upon you and regret for you. How well is the wet nurse, and how bad is the weaner!
The Prophet (S) said: Any people who commend their affairs to a woman will never see prosperity.
The Prophet (S) said: Retain the knowledge by recording.
The Prophet (S) said: Catastrophes should be expected when the sinful become masters, the masters become the humblest, and the sinful ones are respected.
The Prophet (S) said: Speedy walking removes the beauty of the believers.
The Prophet (S) said: The one who was exposed to a theft will insist on accusing innocent people to the degree that his sin becomes greater than the thief is.
The Prophet (S) said: God surely loves him who performs His duties munificently.
The Prophet (S) said: Be kind to the noble who suffers humility (after his nobility), the wealthy who loses (his wealth), and the knowledgeable who becomes in the hands of ignorant people.
The Prophet (S) said: Most people are examined in two characters. They are good health and peace of mind.
The Prophet (S) said: Hearts are molded on cherishing those who treat them charitably and abhorring those who treat them nastily.
The Prophet (S) said: We, the prophets, are ordered to associate with people according to their understandings.
The Prophet (S) said: Cursed be him who imposes his burdens on others.
The Prophet (S) said: Worship is of seven parts, the best of which is seeking legal earnings.
The Prophet (S) said: Beauty is in the tongue (wording).
The Prophet (S) said: Expecting the Relief is the best jihad of my umma.
The Prophet (S) said: The morals of us (the family of the prophesy) are pardoning those who wronged us and giving those who deprived us.
The Prophet (S) said: God will forgive the sins of every believer because of suffering from any sort of fatigue, pain, grief, or care.
The Prophet (S) said: God will never take care of those who have, dress, and ride whatever they desire, unless they desist.
The Prophet (S) said: The like of the believer is the ear: he once falls and once stands erect. The like of the disbeliever is the cedar, he has a steady state that he never feels.
The Prophet (S) said: God will not give any atheist or hypocrite anything of this world if it equals for Him the amount of a mosquito's wing.
The Prophet (S) said: Allah hates two sounds. They are the noise of mourning when a misfortune falls and the sound of a pipe when a blessing falls.
The Prophet (S) said: Cheap prices and just rulers are signs of God's satisfaction with His servants. Unjust rulers and expensive prices are signs of His dissatisfaction with the servants.

The Prophet (S) said: Knowledge is kept in stores the keys of which is questioning. Ask as much as possible, God compassionate you. The reward of asking is recorded for four; the asker, the speaker, the listener, and the favorer.
The Prophet (S) said: Ask the scholars, speak with the wise, and sit with the poor.
The Prophet (S) said: I prefer the merits of knowledge to those of worship. Piety is the best of your religion.
The Prophet (S) said: The angels of the heavens and the earth curse those who issue verdicts baselessly.
The Prophet (S) said: He who pretends of being poor will be poor.
The Prophet (S) said: Courtesy with people is the half of faith and leniency with them is the half of livelihood.
The Prophet (S) said: After believing in God, the head of intelligence is courtesy, provided that no right is neglected. Wit is a happy yield.
The Prophet (S) said: After idolatry, the most insistent matter that I have been warned against is the heated argument.
The Prophet (S) said: He who cheats, injures, or deceives a Muslim is not one of our party.

The Prophet (S) said: When a Muslim deals with a Dhimmi,23 he should say, "O Allah, precede my good to his." But when he deals with another Muslim, he should say, "O Allah, precede the good of both of us."
The Prophet (S) said: God bless the servant who speaks out good wording to gain (the reward) or withholds his bad wording to be saved.
The Prophet (S) said: He who attains any bound unrightfully is one of the aggressors.
The Prophet (S) said: The source of deliberateness is God and the source of hastiness is the Shaytan.
The Prophet (S) said: The obscene, the niggardly, and the vulgar are the remotest from my morals.
The Prophet (S) said: Misbehavior is evil omen.

The Prophet (S) said: May I lead you to the best moralities of this world and the life to come? These moralities are to regard him who disregarded you, give him who deprived you (of his bestowals), and pardon him who wronged you.

The Prophet (S) said: God says: I have accepted this religion for Myself. Except generosity and good manners, nothing will raise it. You should honor the religion by these two traits as long as you accompany it.
The Prophet (S) said: The most faithful of you are the most well-mannered.
The Prophet (S) said: The high mannerism achieves cordiality.
The Prophet (S) said: Happy mien removes malice.
The Prophet (S) said: The best of you are the most well-mannered ones who go on intimate terms with people and people go on intimate terms with them.
The Prophet (S) said: Hands are three; the begging hand, the giving hand, and the grasping hand. The best of hands is the giving hand.
The Prophet (S) said: Pudency is of two categories; pudency of intelligence and pudency of idiocy. Knowledge is the pudency of intelligence, and ignorance is the pudency of idiocy.
The Prophet (S) said: Backbiting is licit against those who strip the dress of pudency.
The Prophet (S) said: Keeping others' deposits brings sustenance and breach of trusts brings poverty.
The Prophet (S) said: Sons' affectionate look at their parents is a sort of worship.
The Prophet (S) said: The most catastrophic situations are to be decapitated compulsorily, to be captured by the enemies, and to find a man lying on one's wife.
The Prophet (S) said: The Divine Throne shakes and the Lord becomes irate whenever a sinful (individual) is praised.
"What is prudence?" a man asked Prophet (S), who answered: Prudence is to obey the wise man after you seek his counsel.
The Prophet (S) said: He who acts ignorantly thwarts more than doing well.
The Prophet (S) said: The fasting person is in state of worship even if he is sleeping in bed unless he commits backbiting.

The Prophet (S) said: He who publicizes an evildoing is (regarded) as same as the originator (of that evildoing). A man who imputes dishonor to a Muslim for a matter will not die before that matter is stuck to him.
The Prophet (S) said: Three categories will wrong you if you do not wrong them: they are the lows, the wife, and the servant.
The Prophet (S) said: Solidity of the eye, hardheartedness, excessive acquisitiveness, and insistence on committing a sin are signs of unhappiness.
The Prophet (S) said: The most complete believer is the most well-mannered.
The Prophet (S) said: Kindness gives embellishment to everything it joins, and clumsiness ruins everything it joins.
The Prophet (S) said: The well clothing expresses richness. Treating the servants kindly suppresses the enemy.
The Prophet (S) said: I have been ordered (by God) to deal with people courteously in the same degree of emphasis on delivering the Divine Message.
The Prophet (S) said: Seek the means of concealment for settling your affairs. Envy chases every grace.
The Prophet (S) said: Faith is two halves; one half is lying in patience and the other in thankfulness.
The Prophet (S) said: The proper fulfillment of the pledges is a part of faith.
The Prophet (S) said: Eating in marts is lowness.

The Prophet (S) said: All the needs are in God's hand while their means are in people's. Seek the needs from God through people. You should be patient in praying to God to settle you needs even if people settle them.
As a man asked him about the party of his umma, the Prophet (S) said: The party of my umma is the community of the right, regardless of their little number.
The Prophet (S) said: God will definitely fulfill the promise that He takes, but if He threatens a punishment, He will have the option to do it or not.
The Prophet (S) said: He who eats and thanks is preferred to him who fasts silently– i.e., does not thank the grace.
The Prophet (S) said: To cherish a believer for the sake of God is one of the greatest classes of faith. He who loves, hates, gives, and bans—all for the sake of God is surely one of the choices.
The Prophet (S) said: God loves most the servants who benefit others, carry out His right properly, and make people like doing favors.
The Prophet (S) said: You should reward them who do you favors. If you cannot reward them, you should thank. Showing gratitude is a sort of rewarding.
The Prophet (S) said: Never dispute or joke with your friend and do not breach your promise to him.
The Prophet (S) said: It is incumbent upon every believer to respect and fulfill the sanctities of the religion, ethics, and food.
The Prophet (S) said: The believer is chipper and joker, while the hypocrites are rude and quick-tempered.
The Prophet (S) said: Richness is a most excellent help on God-fearing.
The Prophet (S) said: Aggression is the quickest in punishment.
The Prophet (S) said: The present is of three sorts; a present for rewarding, a present for flattering, and a present for the sake of God.
The Prophet (S) said: Blessed are those who leave a current passion for obtaining a promised one that they have not seen yet.
The Prophet (S) said: He who reckons tomorrow with the days of his age misbehaves with death.
The Prophet (S) said: Care not for the evil omen. Do not carry out something that you suspect. Do not oppress when you envy.
The Prophet (S) said: You should not be sad when you can no longer dream. The highly educated ones cannot see visions.
The Prophet (S) said: All my people will be virtuous if two classes of them become virtuous and will be reprobate if these two classes become reprobate: they are the jurists and leaders.

The Prophet (S) said: The most intelligent of people are the most fearful of God and the most obedient to Him. The most unintelligent of people are the most fearful of the rulers and the most obedient to them.
The Prophet (S) said: To Sit with three categories of people is to cause your heart to die: they are the lows, women, and the rich.
The Prophet (S) said: Those who try to satisfy a created being by means that cause the Creator's dissatisfaction, God will set up on them that created being as absolute master.
The Prophet (S) said: God has created some people for settling the others' needs. They like doing favors and consider generosity as glory. God surely loves the nobilities of character.
The Prophet (S) said: A (faithful) believer should act upon the moralities that God favors. He should give people when God bestows upon him and withhold when God withholds.
The Prophet (S) said: People will surely live in an age in which a man will not care whether his religious affairs are proper or not as long as his worldly pleasures are satisfactory.
The Prophet (S) said: God has molded the hearts of His creatures on cherishing those who treat them charitably and abhorring those who treat them nastily.
The Prophet (S) said: People will live in an age when they will turn into wolves. He who will not be a wolf will be ravened by wolves.
The Prophet (S) said: The most uncommon (two) things in the last age (of time) are a trustworthy friend and a legal-gotten dirham.
The Prophet (S) said: Guard yourselves against people through mistrusting them.
The Prophet (S) said: The whole welfare is obtained by intelligence only. The mindless have no religion.
The Prophet (S) said: You must reward the hand of help that is extended to you. Thanks, must be introduced if rewarding is impossible. If thank is also neglected, then it is surely ingratitude.
The Prophet (S) said: Shake hands with each other, for it removes malice.
The Prophet (S) said: A faithful believer may get used to any character except telling lies and treachery.
The Prophet (S) said: Some poetry is (words of) wisdom and some speech has magical influence.
The Prophet (S) said: Those who injure the sanctity of the Qur'an do not believe in it.
The Prophet (S) said: God likes to see the signs of His graces on the servants. He hates misery and pretense of misery.
The Prophet (S) said: Good request is half of knowledge, and leniency is half of the livelihood.
The Prophet (S) said: As he gets older, son of Adam (human being) will enjoy two characters; greed and hope.
The Prophet (S) said: Pudency is a part of faith.
The Prophet (S) said: It is illicit to violate anything of the believer: his honor, wealth, and blood—all are sanctified.
The Prophet (S) said: Regard your relatives even by means of mere greeting.
The Prophet (S) said: Faith is a determination in the heart, saying with the tongue, and performance of the pillars of the religion.
The Prophet (S) said: Richness is not the abundance of profits. It is the self-sufficiency.
The Prophet (S) said: To desist from evildoing is charity.
The Prophet (S) said: Some speech has magical influence, some knowledge has ignorance, and some sayings are miraculous.
The Prophet (S) said: Those who please a ruler by means that cause God's dissatisfaction is out of God's religion.
The Prophet (S) said: The offerer of charity is better than the charity itself, and the committer of an evildoing is worse than the evil itself.
The Prophet (S) said: Overlook the faults of the mistaken.
The Prophet (S) said: Ascetics is to disregard hopes, thank for every favor, and refrain from committing any forbidden thing.
The Prophet (S) said: Never do any charity showily and never neglect it because you feel shy.
The Prophet (S) said: I fear for my people to encountering three matters: obeyed niggardliness, pursued fancy, and deviate leaders.

The Prophet (S) said: The physical state of those who live in permanent worry is always unstable. The mentality of the ill- mannered individuals is always bad. The personality and dignity of those who dispute are missing.
The Prophet (S) said: The evilest of my people are those whom people respect for avoiding their evildoing. He whom people respect for avoiding their evildoings are surely not included with my umma.
The Prophet (S) said: Two words are strange: they are a word of wisdom uttered by a foolish. You should accept it. The other is a foolish word uttered by a wise man. You should pardon it.
The Prophet (S) said: The lazy have three signs: he slows until he neglects, neglects until he wastes, and wastes until he commits a sin.
The Prophet (S) said: Mercy falls upon the dispraised charitable ones.
The Prophet (S) said: Accept the presents. The best present is the odor. It is light and sweet-smelling.
By this isnad, he said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: One who is distraught by his sin and joyed by his good deeds is a believer.
Jarir narrated from Ash`ath from Ibn Mas`ud from the Prophet (s). He said: The caliphs after me are twelve like the number of chiefs of the Children of Israel.
By this isnad, he said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Allah said: O son of Adam! Remember Me for a moment after morning and for a moment after `Asr, and I will suffice you from what worries you.
By this isnad, from `Ali (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Close the doors from the street in the Mosque except for the door of `Ali.
And he (as) said: Whomever prays with them (the commoners) in the first row, it is as though he had prayed with the Messenger of Allah (s) in the first row.
By this isnad. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Whoever hears a call in the mosque and leaves it without a [legitimate] reason, then he is a hypocrite, unless he wants to return to it.

By this isnad from Darast b. Abi Mansur from `Abd al-Hamid b. `Awad al-Ta'i from Musa b. Ja`far from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Eating while full begets leprosy.
By its isnad. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: He who informs [the Muslims] of an attack is like one who has freed a slave.
By this isnad. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: He who commends his believing brother to his face but backbites him when he is away shall have the protection (`isma) between them cut away.

It is narrated through the same chain of narrators: "The Messenger of Allah has said, 'Whenever Allah opens the door of gratitude to someone He does not keep the door of increasing (bounties) hidden from him.'"

Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn 'Isa from Yunus from al- Halabi in a marfu' manner from the Messenger of Allah who has said the following: "The salvation of a believer is in his controlling his tongue."

Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from the Messenger of Allah (a.s.) has said, the following: "The Messenger of Allah (a.s.) has said, 'If there is any wickedness, it is in the tongue.'"

Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sukuni, from Abu Abdullah (a.s.), who said: "The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.) forbade the use of reeds and basil twigs as toothpicks."
And by this chain, who has narrated the following: Imam (asws) said: 'The Prophet (saww) said: 'There are two qualities which the people are infatuated with – the health and the leisure'.

Aban, from Abu Baseer who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the statement of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: "In houses which Allah has permitted to be exalted" [24:36], he said: 'They are the houses of the Prophet (sw)'.

It has been reported that Abu Ja'far (a.s) said that the Messenger of Allah (a.s) said:One who makes a believer happy has in fact made me happy; and one who makes me happy has in fact made Allah happy.
It has been narrated that Abu Ja'far (a.s) said: Whoever makes one of our Shi'ah happy will make happy the Messenger of Allah (a.s); and the same is said about one who offends or causes grief.

Al-Maḥāmilī narrated from Dharīḥ, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, "The Messenger of Allah (ṣ) said, 'When Allah wishes goodness for a household, He grants them moderation [and judiciousness] in life[1] and good character.'"

Al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd narrated from Ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, "The Messenger of Allah (ṣ) said, 'I do not like an old man who is ignorant, nor a rich man who is oppressive, nor a poor man who is vain.'"

Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Ḥusayn ibn al-Mukhtār, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) that he said, "Verily when a believer dies, he sees the Messenger of Allah (ṣ) and ʿAlī (a) present before him."
Hadith.9 - The Messenger of Allah (sw), said: "Everything that chews the cud—its leftover water and saliva are permissible."
Hadith.240 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever believes in Allah (swt) and the Last Day (Qiyamah) should not send his wife to the bathhouse."
Hadith.261 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Shave the abdomen hair for both males and females." (And in another version, it includes armpit hair).
Hadith.267 – (Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Farisi Al-Fattal narrates from The Messenger of Allah (sw) ): "Applying Nuura (depilatory paste) on Jumu'ah, it is said that it can lead to leprosy."
Hadith.272 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Dye with henna, for it improves eyesight, promotes hair growth, gives a pleasant fragrance, and calms the wife".
Hadith.287 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said to a man: "Shave (the head) for it enhances your beauty."
Hadith.307 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "None of you should allow their moustache grow long, for Shaytan uses it as a shield to conceal himself".
Hadith.312 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever trims their nails on Saturday and Thursday and trims their mustache will be protected from toothache and eye pain."
Hadith.315 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: For men: 'trim your nails', and for women: 'let your nails grow a bit, for it is (source of) beauty for you.'
Hadith.326 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever grows their hair should take good care of it or cut it short."
Hadith.329 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Trim your mustaches and let your beards grow, and do not resemble the Jews."

Hadith.331 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "The Magians (Zoroastrians) trim their beards and let their mustaches grow long, but we trim the mustaches and let the beards grow, and this is the natural disposition (fitrah)."
Hadith.338 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Gray hair is light, so do not pluck it."
Hadith.357 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Sudden death is an ease and relief for the believer but a regretful taking for the disbeliever".
Hadith.371 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever dies on a Jumu'ah or on the night of Jumu'ah, Allah (swt) will relieve him from the punishment of the grave."
Hadith.385 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "The honor of the deceased is their hastening (to be buried)."

Hadith.502 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever consoles a grieving person will be clothed in a robe of honor on the Day of Standing (the Day of Judgment), which will bring them joy (and honor)."

Hadith.551 – Imam (as) said was asked about the reward (ajr) of the mourning woman (nā'iḥah), Imam (as) said: "There is no issue with it, for mourning (niyaḥah) was done for the Messenger of Allah (sw)."

Hadith.619 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever is overly cautious about his clothing during prayer (focusing excessively on keeping it clean or arranged), is not truly clothing himself for Allah (swt)".
Hadith.622 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Prayer is a balance, so whoever fulfils it properly will receive their due reward."
Hadith.686 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever comes to my mosque, the Mosque of Quba, and prays two rak'ahs in it, it is as if they have performed an 'Umrah."

Hadith.714 - The Prophet (sw), heard a man searching for a lost item in the mosque and said: "Say to him, 'May Allah (swt) not return your lost item to you,' for the mosque was not built for this purpose."
Hadith.772 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "A man should not pray while wearing an iron ring."

Hadith.906 - Bilal used to call to prayer after the morning (Fajr), and The Prophet (sw) said: "Indeed, Ibn Umm Maktum calls to prayer during the night, so if you hear his adhan, eat and drink until you hear the adhan of Bilal."

Hadith.1058 - Abu Basir said to him: "I hear someone sneeze, and I praise Allah (swt) and send blessings upon the Prophet (sw) while I am in prayer." Imam (as) said: "Yes, even if there is a sea between you and your companion."
Hadith.1092 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said to a group of people: "You must attend the mosque, or I will burn down your houses."
Hadith.1099 - The Prophet (sw) said: "If the sandals are wet, then pray in your dwellings."
Hadith.1100 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "The Imam of the people is their representative, so choose the best among you to lead."

Hadith.1102 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever leads a people in prayer while there is someone among them who is more knowledgeable than him, their affairs will continue to decline until the Day of Judgment."
Hadith.1125 - It is narrated from him by Hammad ibn Uthman that Imam (as) said: "Whoever prays with them in the first row, it is as if he prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (sw) in the first row".

Hadith.1139 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Straighten your rows, for I see you from behind me just as I see you from in front of me and from before me. Do not differ, lest Allah (swt) cause discord among your hearts."
Hadith.1187 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever leads a group in prayer and reserves the supplication for himself, excluding them, has betrayed them".
Hadith.1248 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Make your families happy every Jumu'ah by providing them with something of fruit and meat so that they may rejoice in the day of Jumu'ah."
Hadith.1250 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "If you see an elder discussing stories of the pre-Islamic era (Jahiliyyah) on the day of Jumu'ah, throw stones at his head, even if with pebbles".
Hadith.1255 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "O' Allah (swt), bless my Ummah (community) in its early morning on their Saturdays and Thursdays."
Hadith.1260 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever attends the Jumu'ah prayer with faith and seeking the reward (from Allah (swt)), his deeds will be renewed".
Hadith.1272 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever performs four units of prayer during travel, I disassociate myself from him in front of Allah (swt)".
Hadith.1370 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Whoever increases their prayers during the night will have a radiant face during the day."
Hadith.1399 - The Prophet (sw) said in his advice to Imam Ali (as): "O' Ali, adhere to the night prayer, adhere to the night prayer, adhere to the night prayer".

Hadith.1520 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Do not curse the winds, for they are commanded (by Allah (swt)), nor the mountains, nor the hours, nor the days, nor the nights, lest you commit a sin and it returns to you."

Hadith.1559 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Perform supererogatory (extra) prayers during the time of heedlessness, even if it is just two light rak'ahs (units of prayer), for they lead to the abode of honor."
Hadith.1684 - Imam (as) said: "Any believer who extends kindness to his fellow believer has indeed extended that kindness to the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family)."
Hadith.1725 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: "Whoever extends a favor to any of my household, I will repay them on the Day of Judgment."
Hadith.1735 - The Prophet (sw), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Charity given in secret extinguishes the wrath of the Lord (azj), majestic and exalted is He."
Hadith.1737 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "If a male beggar comes to you at night, do not turn him away."

Hadith.1746 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (sw) said: "Do not interrupt the request of a beggar, for if it were not for the fact that some of the needy lie, those who turn them away would never prosper."

Hadith.1772 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "The fasting person is in a state of worship, even if he is sleeping on his bed, as long as he does not backbite a Muslim."
Hadith.1803 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "Whoever fasts a day in the way of Allah (swt), it is equivalent to fasting a whole year."
Hadith.2136 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Allah (swt) made this sacrifice (Adha) so that your needy may be satisfied with meat, so feed them."
Hadith.2190 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Choose the best of your sacrifices, for they are your mounts on the Sirat (Bridge)."
Hadith.2195 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Casting the pebbles at the Jamarat is a provision for the Day of Judgment."
Hadith.2196 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "When the pilgrim casts the pebbles at the Jamarat, they are cleansed of their sins."
Hadith.2222 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Whoever seeks both this world and the Hereafter, let them visit this House."

Hadith.2231 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Every blessing will be questioned about by its owner, except for that which was used in battle or Hajj."
Hadith.2394 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Travel by night, for the earth is folded during the night."

Hadith.2436 - Al-Sakuni narrated with his chain of transmission that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said: "First the companion, then the journey."

Hadith.2454 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said: "Part of a man's dignity is that he makes his provisions pleasant when he sets out on a journey."
Hadith.2471 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said: "Do not sit sideways on animals, and do not make their backs your seats."
Hadith.2486 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said: "Camels are a source of honor for their owners."

Hadith.2517 - Abdullah ibn Maymun narrated with his chain of transmission that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said: "If you lose your way, turn to the right."
Hadith.3234 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Whoever is tested with judging should not pass judgment while he is angry."
Hadith.3418 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "The protected area (harim) of a palm tree is the length of its fronds."
Hadith.3959 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: "No one hoards food except a sinner."
Hadith.3961 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: "The one who brings goods to the market is blessed with sustenance, and the hoarder is cursed."
Hadith.3965 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: "Measure your food, for indeed, the blessing is in the measured food."
Hadith.3570 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Wealth is an excellent aid in attaining piety towards Allah (swt)."
Hadith.3616 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Part of honor and dignity is managing wealth properly."
Hadith.3619 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "Indeed, when the soul secures its provision, it becomes content."

Hadith.4070 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (may Allah (swt) bless him and his family) said: "If I were invited to a meal consisting of a trotter, I would accept, and if I were gifted a trotter, I would accept it."
Hadith.4147 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "Every predatory animal with fangs and every bird with talons is unlawful."
Hadith.4267 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "What an excellent condiment vinegar is! A house that has vinegar will never be destitute."

Hadith.4301 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Whoever takes an oath in private should make an exception in private, and whoever takes an oath publicly should make an exception publicly."
Hadith.4345 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Take a spouse, for it is a means of increasing your sustenance."
Hadith.4348 - It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Indeed, the most despicable of your dead are the unmarried."
Hadith.4361 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Marry women with blue eyes, for indeed there is blessing in them."

Hadith.4371 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "I have not seen those who are weak in faith and deficient in intellect more capable of overwhelming a man of reason than you (women)."
Hadith.4538 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "The best of you is the one who is best to his wives, and I am the best of you to my wives."
Hadith.4629 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "The private parts of the women of my nation are forbidden to the men of my nation."
Hadith.4903 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "When a woman leaves her seat, no one should sit in that place until it has cooled down."
Hadith.4908 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "The best among you is the one who is best to his family, and I am the best among you to my family."
Hadith.4963 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Indeed, my intercession is for the sinners who commit major sins from my nation."
Hadith.4978 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Adultery brings about poverty and leaves homes deserted."

Hadith.5146 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Avert prescribed punishments through doubts. There is no intercession, no guarantee, and no oath in matters of prescribed punishments."
Hadith.5784 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Now the battle (battlefield) has intensified." (Spoken on the Day of Battle of Hunayn)
Hadith.5763 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The upper hand is better than the lower hand."
Hadith.5764 - The Prophet (sw) said; "That which is little but sufficient is better than that which is abundant and distracts."
Hadith.5766 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The foundation of wisdom is the fear of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic."
Hadith.5765 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The best provision (for hereafter) is piety."
Hadith.5767 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The best of things that can be placed in the heart is certainty.
Hadith.5768 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Doubt (in religion) is part of disbelief."
Hadith.5769 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Wailing is an act of the Age of Ignorance."
Hadith.5772 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Alcohol is the source of all sins."
Hadith.5774 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Youth is a branch of madness (irrationality)."
Hadith.5776 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The worst of foods (wealth) is consuming the wealth of an orphan unjustly."
Hadith.5777 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The fortunate one is he who learns a lesson from others."
Hadith.5778 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The wretched one is he who is destined for wretchedness while in his mother's womb."
Hadith.5779 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Your ultimate destination (grave) is four cubits."
Hadith.5782 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Whoever suppresses anger, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, will reward him."
Hadith.5783 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Whoever is patient during a calamity, Allah (swt) will compensate him."
Hadith.5785 - The Prophet (sw) said; "A believer is not stung from the same hole twice."
Hadith.5786 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Affliction (harm) does not come to a person except with his own hand."
Hadith.5787 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The strong one is the one who overcomes himself (nafs)."
Hadith.5788 - The Prophet (sw) said; "'Hearing' (with the ears) is not equivalent to 'seeing' (with the eyes)."
Hadith.5789 - The Prophet (sw) said; "O' Allah (swt), bless my nation in its (utilizing) early mornings on its Saturdays and Thursdays."
Hadith.5790 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Gatherings are based on trust." (referring to that which is said and heard during gatherings)
Hadith.5791 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The leader of a people should serve (the people)."
Hadith.5792 - The Prophet (sw) said; "If (even) a mountain were to oppress another mountain, Allah (swt) would crush it to dust."
Hadith.5793 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Begin (good behaviors and conduct) with those whom you support (family)."
Hadith.5794 - The Prophet (sw) said; "War is deception." (War obfuscates truth, and is lacking in transparency and truth)
Hadith.5795 - The Prophet (sw) said; "A Muslim is a mirror to his brother."
Hadith.5796 - The Prophet (sw) said; "He died a natural death." (spoken regarding a person who dies whilst not partaking in active jihad)
Hadith.5797 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Affliction is connected to speech." (words can bring about trials or difficulties)
Hadith.5798 - The Prophet (sw) said; "People are equal like the teeth of a comb."
Hadith.5802 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The quickest evil to be punished is oppression." (by Allah (swt) in the Hereafter)
Hadith.5803 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The fastest good to be rewarded is righteousness." (by Allah (swt) in the Hereafter)
Hadith.5804 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Muslims are bound by their agreements." (that they make to others)
Hadith.5805 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Indeed, some poetry contains wisdom, and indeed, some speech has a magical effect."
Hadith.5806 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Show mercy to those on the earth, and the One (Allah (swt)) in the heavens will show mercy to you."
Hadith.5807 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Whoever is killed defending his wealth is a martyr."
Hadith.5808 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The one who takes back his gift is like the one who returns to his vomit."
Hadith.5809 - The Prophet (sw) said; "It is not permissible for a believer to abandon his believing brother for more than three days."
Hadith.5810 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Whoever does not show mercy (to others) will not be shown mercy (by Allah (swt) in the Hereafter)."
Hadith.5811 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Regret (of a sin) is (a form of) repentance."
Hadith.5812 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The child is attributed to the (lawful) bed, and for the adulterer, there is the stone (hadd)."
Hadith.5813 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The one who guides to good is like the one who does it."
Hadith.5814 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Your love for something blinds and deafens you." (to its faults and catches)
Hadith.5815 - The Prophet (sw) said; "He does not (rightfully) thank Allah (swt), who does not thank people." (for doing good onto him)
Hadith.5816 - The Prophet (sw) said; "No one shelters the misguided except the misguided."

Hadith.5818 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The souls are like recruited soldiers; those that recognize one another will find harmony, and those that do not will be in discord." (regarding spiritual affinity between individuals)
Hadith.5819 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The delay in (due) payment by a wealthy person is injustice."
Hadith.5820 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Travel (discomforts) is a portion of torment."
Hadith.5821 - The Prophet (sw) said; "People are like mines, just as gold and silver mines."
Hadith.5822 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The host of a gathering has the most right to the forefront of his gathering."
Hadith.5823 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Throw dust onto the faces of those who excessively praise (you)." (advises rejecting excessive flattery)
Hadith.5824 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Bring down means of sustenance (from Allah (swt)) through (giving) charity."
Hadith.5825 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Repel affliction with supplication." (emphasizes the power of supplication (dua) in warding off difficulties and hardships)
Hadith.5826 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Hearts are naturally inclined to love those who do good to them and to dislike those who harm them."
Hadith.5827 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Wealth does not decrease because of (giving in) charity."
Hadith.5828 - The Prophet (sw) said; "There is no charity while a close relative is in need." (needy relatives have a bigger right over the money that was to be given in charity elsewhere)
Hadith.5829 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Health and free time are two neglected blessings." (failing to recognize the true value of good health and downtime or spare time)
Hadith.5830 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The forgiveness of a king preserves the kingdom longer."
Hadith.5831 - The Prophet (sw) said; "A man's gift to his wife increases her chastity." (strengthens her sense of loyalty and affinity for her husband)
[7/-] From the messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه واله who said: whoever preserves forty of our narrations Allah will raise him on the day of judgment as a scholar possessing understanding.
A man stood up and said : O Amīr al-mu'minīn tell us about this disturbance and whether you enquired about it from the Holy Prophet.
What Amīr al-mu'minīn said on the occasion of the burial of Sayyidatu'n-nisā' (Supreme lady) Fāṭimah (as) while addressing the Holy Prophet (sw) at his grave.
The Prophet (S) said this at a time when the religion was confined to a few, but now that its expanse has widened and it is firmly settled everyone is free in his action. [1]
(The same previous series of relaters)… The Prophet (s) said: He who is displeased by his evil deeds and pleased by his good deeds, then he is a believer.
The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) says: Till date, I and those who preceded me never said anything equal to 'There is no God except Allah'.
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his forefathers that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) said: (Saying) 'There is no God except Allah' is the best worship act.

The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) says: Sins are erased from the scroll of deeds of every believer who says: 'There is no God except Allah' and good deeds equal to the number of sins are bestowed on him.
The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) says, "The color of dye, which Allah likes the most is dark black."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, "Combing one's hair keeps away plague, increases earnings and increases sexual power."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, "One who trims his nails and moustache on Thursday or Saturday will remain safe from the pain of teeth and eyes."
It is narrated by Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) from his predecessors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Trimming nails prevents serious hardships and increases one's earnings."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, "One who lights a lamp in the mosque of Allah the people of heaven and Allah's angels seek repentance for that person till the time that lamp is on in the mosque."

Imam Ridha (a.s.) narrates from his predecessors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "The reward of a Salaat offered in Masjidul Haraam is more than the reward of a hundred thousand prayers offered in some other mosque."
Amirul Momineen (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "The best among you are those who offer Qasr prayer and do not observe fast during travel."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, "A two-rakat Salaat offered with complete attention is better than to stand the whole night (in prayers)."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his predecessors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "The sleep of a fasting person is like worship and his breath is like glorification of Allah."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, "One who observes a fast in the way of Allah is like a person fasting for a whole year."
The narrator says that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) did not use to fast for a whole month except in Shaban, which he used to link with Ramadan.
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, "One who remains awake during the night of Eid his heart would remain alive on the day the hearts are destined to die."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, "One who stays awake during the night of Eid and of 15th Shaban his heart would remain alive on the day the hearts are destined to die."

Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) says that a person who does the Ziyarat of Imam Husain (a.s.) once knowing his right is like one who has performed Hajj a hundred times along with the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.).

It is narrated from Amirul Momineen (a.s.) that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who recites Surah Tauheed a hundred times before going to bed, Allah will forgive sins committed by him in the past fifty years."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who sits with religious people will be honored in the world and the hereafter."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his predecessors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Sadaqah keeps one away from unpleasant death."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "The Sadaqah given at the time of prosperity is the best Sadaqah."

Imam Ridha (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who recites salutation on me a hundred times on Friday, the Almighty Allah will fulfill his thirty desires of this world and the hereafter each."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Recite salutation loudly, for it keeps away hypocrisy from you."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "When one of you supplicates it should be for everyone in general, because it a factor for acceptance of supplications."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "There is a cure for every malady and the cure of sins is repentance."
Imam Muhammad (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who has Astaghfirullaah written under each of his sin on the Day of Judgment is indeed fortunate."

Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his predecessors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Tooba (Congratulations) be for one who avoids lust today for the sake of those promised things he has not seen."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who resists his own self instead of people, will get protection against the fear of the Day of Judgment."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who takes a letter of a warrior to its destination, will be like one who has freed a slave and will get the reward of participating in that Jihad."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "The reward till the Day of Judgment is tied to the forehead of a horse."

Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that Amirul Momineen narrated that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "The squeeze of grave for a believer is the atonement for the bounties wasted by him."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who says words of condolence to a sad person, will be awarded a fine dress to be worn on the Day of Judgment."
It is narrated from Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "People who hate us, Ahle Bayt will be raised on the Day of Judgment as lepers (having no hands)."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Two types of people from my Ummah have no part in Islam and they are Murjiah and Qadiriya."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Those who are biased have removed the necklace of Islam from their necks and thrown it away."
Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Keep away from taking false oaths because it causes the cities to become vacant of its residents."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Taking false oaths in case of helplessness causes entire cities to become vacant of its residents."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors and Jabir that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "There is no difference between a believer and a disbeliever except for the avoidance of Salaat."

Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Abusing a believer, doing hypocrisy and killing him is disbelief. And eating his flesh (Backbiting) is disobedience of Allah."
The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "There are four things viz. betrayal of trust, theft, drinking wine and fornication which cannot enter a house except that the house is unpleasant and deprived."

Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who spreads scandal is like one who started it. One who hurts a believer in any way will not die until he has faced the same calamity."
Imam Ridha narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "When my community stops enjoining good and restraining from evil, it should be prepared to wage war against Allah, hallowed be His name."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "If a woman goes out after applying perfume, she will be cursed till the time she returns."

It is narrated that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who takes up the leadership of ten persons and is not able to do justice to them, will come on the Day of Judgment with his hands, feet and head perforated."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "A person who cheats Muslims is not from us."

The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who usurps the wealth of a believer unlawfully, Allah will have hatred and enmity with him and his good deeds will not be accepted till he repents and returns the wealth to its owner."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "One who walks on earth proudly, the earth and all the creatures above and below it curse him."
Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Curse be on one who walks on the earth proudly for he is clashing against the Omnipotent One of the earth and heavens."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "If a mountain does injustice to another mountain the Almighty Allah will raze it to the ground."
Imam Ja'far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "The evil deed to be punished first is injustice."
Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) narrates that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, "Do not be surprised with a person who murders excessively because his killer is with Allah who will never die."
And with this isnad, he said: The Messenger of Allah (sw) said, "O Ali! You are the best of men. No one except a disbeliever has any doubts about you."

251 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said, "Start your workday activities by giving charity. This will aid in your prayers not being rejected."

253 According to the same documentation, the Prophet (S) said, "The best of the women of the Quraysh (tribe) who ride camels are the ones who are kind to their husbands."

263 According to the same documentation, it has been narrated that Ali (a.s.) said that the Prophet (S) told him, "Your position relative to me is like that of Aaron's position relative to Moses (a.s.)."

268 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said, "People are from different trees. You and I are from the same tree."
269 According to the same documentation, it is narrated that Ali (a.s.) said, "The Prophet (S) wore his ring on his right hand."
270 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said, "A rebellious group will kill Ammar."

305 According to the same documentation,the Prophet (S) said, "Ali's hand is the same as my hand."
308 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said, "Soon my nation will treat you with treachery and the good and the bad will all follow them."
309 According to the same documentation, the Prophet (S) said, "Whoever swears at Ali has indeed sworn at me, and whoever swears at me has indeed cursed God."

Imam Ali.text: Imam Ali ('a) said: The best friend is good mannerism. It is the title of the believers' record books.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The true abstinent in this world is he whose tolerance is not overcome by the ill-gotten matters and whose gratitude is not engaged by the legal gotten matters.

Imam Ali ('a) said: When you cherish someone, you should cherish him moderately for he may be your enemy someday, and when you hate someone, you should hate him moderately for he may be your friend someday.
Imam Ali ('a) said: No wealth like intelligence and no poverty harsher than ignorance.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Fear is attached to disappointment, and pudency is attached to deprivation. Wisdom is the lost property of the believer who should seek it even if it is found with the evil ones.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Tolerance, silence, and expecting the Relief are the best of worship.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The rank of patience to faith is as same as the rank of the head to the body. Hence, the impatient are faithless.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Do not be angry and do not enrage others. Exchange greetings and use good wording.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The generous becomes lenient when his clemency is beseeched, but the mean becomes more severe when he is treated kindly.

Imam Ali ('a) said: For you, I am only afraid of two things—prolonged hope and pursuance of passions. The pro-longed hope makes you forget the life to come, and the pursuance of passions precludes you from the right.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Do not befriend the enemy of your friend lest you become the enemy of your friend.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Do not desert your friend due to suspicion and do not leave him before you blame him.

Imam Ali ('a) said: Steadfastness is of three sorts—steadfastness against misfortunes, steadfastness in (performing) the acts of obedience to God, and steadfastness by the avoidance of the acts of disobedience to Him.
Imam Ali ('a) said: No one can find the true taste of faith before he believes that whatever befalls him would never miss him and whatever missed him would never befall him.

Imam Ali ('a) said: He who satisfies himself with only what suffices him from the worldly affairs will be sufficed with the least of it, but whoever is dissatisfied with what suffices him nothing at all will suffice him.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Do favor to whomever you want and he will be your prisoner.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Flattery and envy are not within the characters of a believer except when they are used for seeking studies.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The supports of atheism are four. They are desire for the worldly pleasures, fear from missing any worldly pleasure, dissatisfaction with the acts of God, and anger.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Patience is the key to the achievement, and success is the end result of the patient. For every seeker of a matter there is a definite time that is controlled by the destiny.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Tongue is a measure that is lowered by ignorance and outweighed by mind.
Imam Ali ('a) said: For those who avenge themselves improperly, God will inflict humility upon them. Certainly, God is the enemy of whatever He detests.
Imam Ali ('a) said: He who seeks good will never feel perplexed and he who seeks others 'consult will never feel sorry.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Countries were constructed because of patriotism.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Sciences are three—jurisprudence for the knowledge of religions, medicine for the cure of the bodies, and grammar for the correction of the language.
Imam Ali ('a) said: God's rights (that are incumbent upon His servants) in difficulty are satisfaction and patience, and His rights in ease are praise and gratitude.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Knowledge is the leader, act is the driver, and the soul is balky.
Imam Ali ('a) said: People's similarity to their rulers is more than their similarity to their fathers.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Earnings are given the authority on foolishness, deprivation is bound to mind, and misfortune is bound to patience.

One day, Imam Ali ('a) rode a pack animal and some people walked with him. As he noticed so, he said: Do you not know that walking with the rider ruins the manners of the rider and humiliate the walker? Leave me now.

As he was asked about pure repentance, Imam Ali ('a) said: A pure repentance is feeling of sorrow in the heart, seeking forgiveness with the tongue (by utterance), and the intention not to do so ever again.

As a man asked him for an advice, Imam Ali ('a) said to him: I advise you not to state a limit for the numerousness of deeds of charity and not to state a limit for the scantiness of acts of disobedience to God.
As a man asked him for an advice, Imam Ali ('a) said to him: Do not think of poverty and longevity.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Long hope will unavoidably lead to the negligence of acting good deeds.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The most similar thing to son of Adam (man) is the scales, since people are either imperfect due to ignorance or outbalancing due to knowledge.
Imam Ali ('a) said: To revile at the believers is defection, to fight them is atheism, and their wealth is as sacred as their blood (soul).
Imam Ali ('a) said: Offer your soul and wealth to your friend, offer your equity and fairness for your enemy, and offer your courtesy and charity for people. Greet people so that they will greet you.
Imam Ali ('a) said: In this world, the masters of people are the openhanded, while in the world to come the God-fearing will be the masters.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Shutting the mouth is the first stage of rupture of relations. Never feel sorry for the bored. The ugliest reward is the bad turn.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Satisfy yourself and you will gain dignity.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Patience is a shelter against poverty. Care is the sign of destitute. Moderation is the avoidance of indigence. Admonition is the haven of him who seeks its refuge.
Imam Ali ('a) said: He whose dress is chosen by knowledge will have his defects screened from people.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The envious cannot enjoy nice life. The bored cannot be given amiability. The liars are lacking personality.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Keep your dignity up by means of loneliness.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Every powerful that is under God's control is humble.
Imam Ali ('a) said: People perish due to two things—fear of poverty and seeking of pride.
Imam Ali ('a) said: O people, beware of fondness of this world, because it is the head of every sin, the door to every misfortune, the companion of every sedition, and the caller to every disaster.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Say good wording and it will be your distinctive feature. Do good deeds and you will be reckoned with its people.
Imam Ali ('a) said: No one will find the true taste of faith before he neglects telling lies whether seriously or jokingly.
Imam Ali ('a) said: A Muslim should avoid associating with the liars, because the liars will not be believed even when they tell truths.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The gravest sin is to seize the wealth of a Muslim wrongly.
Imam Ali ('a) said: He who fears retaliation will abstain from oppressing people.
Imam Ali ('a) said: I have never seen like the wrong envious who is most similar to the wronged.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The wrongdoer, his supporter, and the one who desires for wrongdoing are three partners of the same evil.

Imam Ali ('a) said: O Allah, do not cause me to need any of the evils. When I need, make my need with the best humored, the most generous, the most eloquent, and the less referrer to the favor that he has done to me.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Blessed are those who exchange intimate terms with people for the sake of obedience to God.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Keep the deposits even if their owners were the murderers of the prophets' sons.
Imam Ali ('a) said: God-fearing is the origin of faith.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The humiliation of obedience to God is more favorable than the honor of the disobedience to God.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Wealth and sons are the harvest of this world, and the good deed is the harvest of the world to come. God has given some people both.

Imam Ali ('a) said: The core of a man is his tongue, his mind is his religion, and his personality is the situation that he chooses for himself. Earnings are distributed. Days are changeable. To Adam, all people return equally.
Imam Ali ('a) said: He who does not humor those who he has to humor is not wise.
Imam Ali ('a) said: No one can find the true taste of faith before he believes that whatever befalls him would never miss him and whatever missed him would never befall him.
Imam Ali ('a) said: A true friend is that who regards in misfortunes, absence, and after death.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The hearts of the ignorant are stirred up by greed, captured by hopes, and locked up by trickeries.
Imam Ali ('a) said: He who puts himself in situations of accusation should not blame those who doubt him. He who conceals his secrets will have his decisions in the hand.

Imam Ali ('a) said: God will punish the Arabs for their extremism, the lords for their arrogance, the rulers for their inequity, the scholars for their envy, the tradesmen for their fraud, and the villagers for their ignorance.
Imam Ali ('a) said: O people, fear God. The steadfastness in God-fearing is surely more acceptable than God's punishment.
Imam Ali ('a) said: The ascesis in this world is to neglect expectation, thank (God) for every grace, and refrain from whatever God has forbidden.
Imam Ali ('a) said: When things were combined, indolence and incapacity combined and produced poverty.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Silence is wisdom, abstinence from speaking is safety, and concealment is a part of happiness.
Imam Ali ('a) said: All matters are submissive to the predestined until defect occurs to the management.
As he was asked about personality, Imam Ali ('a) said: Personality is to avoid doing a matter secretly if you feel embarrassed to do it openly.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Seeking God's forgiveness along with the insistence on committing the sin from which you seek forgiveness are additional sins.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Settle the acknowledgement of what you worship in yourselves so that the movements of your organs will benefit you in the worship of what you acknowledge.
Imam Ali ('a) said: For him who dedicates his religion to the obtainment of his worldly pleasures, his reward will be only that which he has benefited through his religion.
Imam Ali ('a) said: Faith is accepted saying, applied action, and acknowledgement in the minds.
Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated in a marfu' manner who has said the following: "'Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s.), has said, 'Moderation leads to increase, and extravagance leads to destruction.'"

Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated in a marfu' manner the following: "Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s.), has said, 'When things (works) double, laziness and failure join hands, and they both give birth to poverty.'"

Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: "'Amir al-Mu'minin 'Alayhi al-Salam, has said, 'A man who follows (unlawful) policies of woman is condemned.'"
Ali ibn Muhammad in a marfu' manner has said the following: "'Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s.), would brush his teeth widthwise and eat using all of his fingers.'"

It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from certain persons of his people in a marfu' manner who has said the following: "'Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s.), would eat leeks with not so finely powdered salt.'"

Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Ya'qub ibn Yazid in a marfu' manner has said the following: "'Amir al-Mu'minin, has said, 'Water of the Nile of Misr (Egypt) deadens the heart.'"

Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: "He (the Imam) said that 'Amir al-Mu'minin has said, 'Brushing one's teeth cleanses the mouth and earns Allah's pleasure.'"
Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Sulaym al-Farra' who said: "Amir al-Mu'minin (a.s.) said, 'Lime is a cleansing (agent).'"
Hadith.112 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Your mouths are the pathways of the Quran, so purify them with siwak (toothstick)."
Hadith.166 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: 'I do not concern myself with whether urine or water has touched me if I am unaware of it.'.
Hadith.254 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Nuura (depilatory paste) is a purifier."
Hadith.258 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "I like for a believer to use Nuura (depilatory paste) every fifteen days."

Hadith.264 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Removing armpit hair eliminates unpleasant odors and is a means of purification and a practice (Sunnah) that was commanded by the Good and Pure Prophet (sw)."
Hadith.274 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Dyeing (the hair or beard) is the tradition of Muhammad (sw) and it is part of the Sunnah."
Hadith.293 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Washing the head with Al-khatmi (a type of herbal shampoo or marshmallow root) removes dirt and purifies impurities".

Hadith.391 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "The one who washes the deceased should be the closest person to them or the one whom the guardian (Wali) of the deceased appoints for this task."
Hadith.579 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Whoever renovates a grave or creates a figure (idol/statue) has exited Islam."

Hadith.708 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) saw a mosque in Kufa that had been decorated or elevated and said: "It is as if it is a church. Mosques are not to be adorned; they should be built plain (simple)."

Hadith.722 - It is narrated that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), passed by a tall minaret and ordered it to be demolished. He then said: "The minaret should not be raised higher than the roof of the mosque".
Hadith.758 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "A sword is like a garment; you may pray with it as long as you do not see any blood on it. A bow is also like a garment."
Hadith.767 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said in what he taught his companions: "Do not wear black, for it is the clothing of Pharaoh."
Hadith.1495 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "The clouds are the sieve of the rain; without that, it would ruin everything it falls upon".
Hadith.1606 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Charity is not sold until it is apportioned."
Hadith.1717 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "If Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has no need for a servant, He tests him with miserliness."
Hadith.1722 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "The first thing to be rewarded in the Hereafter is the charity of providing water."
Hadith.1759 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), said: "Be independent of people, even if it is with the splinters of a toothstick."

Hadith.1875 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Does one of you not feel ashamed that they cannot endure (fasting) until the evening? It was said in the past that the beginning of fighting is slapping."
Hadith.1914 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), said: "The testimony of women is not accepted for the sighting of the crescent; only the testimony of two just men is accepted."

Hadith.1923 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), said: "Breaking my fast on one day in the Month of Ramadan is more beloved to me than fasting one day from Sha'ban and adding it to the Month of Ramadan."
Hadith.2145 - The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Looking at Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) is an act of worship."
Hadith.2146 - In another narration, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "The mention of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) is an act of worship."
Hadith.2438 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Do not accompany in travel anyone who does not regard you with the same esteem that you regard them."
Hadith.2481 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Whoever among you travels with an animal should begin, when stopping, by feeding and giving water to it."
Hadith.3061 – Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "A sacrifice is not performed on behalf of one who is in the womb."
Hadith.3131 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "You have been commanded to perform Hajj and Umrah, so do not worry about which one you begin with."

Hadith.3223 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said to Shurayh: "O Shurayh, you have sat in a position that none has sat in except a prophet, the executor of a prophet, or a wretched person."

Hadith.3239 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said to Shurayh: "O Shurayh, do not speak privately with anyone in your court. And if you become angry, stand up and do not pass judgment while you are angry."
Hadith.3964 - Abu Ishaq narrated from Al-Harith, from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, who said: "Whoever hoards food, mercy is removed from him."
Hadith.3675 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Whoever takes payment for teaching the Quran, his share will be [taken] on the Day of Judgment."
Hadith.3681 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Beware of debt, for it is worry at night and humiliation during the day."
Hadith.3682 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Beware of debt, for it is humiliation during the day, worry at night, accountability in this world, and accountability in the Hereafter."

Hadith.3736 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) passed by a bondwoman who had bought meat from a butcher and was asking him to add more. Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said to the butcher: "Give her more, for it brings greater blessings."
Hadith.3739 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) passed by a man who had goods he wanted to sell and said to him, "Go to the beginning of the market."

Hadith.3846 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Whatever the partner spends during his travel is taken from the joint capital. However, when he returns to his town, whatever he spends is from his own share."

Hadith.3916 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious: "And upon Allah (swt) let the reliant rely" (Surah Ibrahim 14:12). Imam (as) said: "It refers to the farmers."

Hadith.3929 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) was presented with the case of a bathhouse attendant with whom clothes were deposited, but they were lost. Imam (as) did not hold him liable and said: "He is merely a trustee."
Hadith.4313 - And Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Swear by Allah (swt) falsely and save your brother from being killed."

Hadith.4383 - Imam (as) said: "Had Allah (swt), the Exalted, not created Sayyida Fatimah {s.a} for Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), there would not have been any equal for her on the face of the earth, from Adam to those after him."
Hadith.4401 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Indeed, the most deserving of conditions to be fulfilled are those by which you make lawful access to private parts."
Hadith.4448 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Stepdaughters are prohibited for you, whether they were raised in your household or not."

Hadith.4487 - Hammad ibn Isa asked Abu Abdillah (as) about how many wives can a slave marry? He (as) said: My father (as) said that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "He may not marry more than two wives."
Hadith.4534 - Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said: "Inspire them with the love of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) and leave them in their natural simplicity."
Hadith.4622 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Any man who is ruled by a woman is cursed."
Hadith.4623 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "There is blessing in opposing them."
Hadith.4663 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "There is no milk with greater blessing for a child to be nursed with than the milk of his mother."
Hadith.4694 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "When a child falls ill, it serves as an expiation for the sins of the parents."

Hadith.4790 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni, he said that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "The expenses of a pregnant woman whose husband has passed away are to be provided from the entire wealth until she gives birth."
Hadith.4850 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni, it is reported that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "The umm al-walad (woman who has borne her master's child) is included in the ruling of ẓihar."
Hadith.4957 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Whoever walks towards a person of innovation and shows him respect has indeed contributed to the destruction of Islam."
Hadith.4965 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "There is no intercessor more successful than repentance."

Hadith.5074 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Whoever acknowledges a child and then denies him is to be given the legal punishment and held responsible for the child."

Hadith.5076 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "There is no legal punishment upon a mad person until they regain sanity, nor upon a child until they reach maturity, nor upon a sleeping person until they wake up."
Hadith.5104 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "Every place that can be entered without permission, and a thief steals from it, there is no cutting off of the hand."
Amir al-mu'minin, peace be upon him, said: I have never entertained doubt about right since I was shown it.
87 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "When you cook use a lot of gourds since it strengthens mental powers."
103 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "No one can go into seclusion in the mosque without fasting."
104 According to the same documentation, the Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "Those of you who have the best temper are the ones with the most perfect faith."

105 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "Hiding one's good deeds, perseverance in the face of hardships and not disclosing one's calamities are all parts of the treasure of goodness."
106 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "Being good-tempered is the best companion."
111 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "Three things improve the memory and eliminate phlegm: Reciting the Qur'an, honey and chewing frankincense."
115 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "You should avoid the following three things while you fast: Bath, phlebotomy (blood-letting) and beautiful women."

129 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "I advise you to eat meat since it will strengthen your muscles. Whoever abstains from eating meat for forty days will get bad-tempered."

131 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "The Prophet (S) never forbade eating kidneys, but he (a.s.) wouldn't eat them. The Prophet (S) said it was because they produce urine."
133 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "Whoever eats twenty-one red raisins on an empty stomach will no longer find any ailments in his body."
134 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "When God's Prophet (S) ate dates, he put the seeds on the back of his hands and threw them away."
137 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "I advise you to eat gourds since they strengthen mental powers."
139 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "Plague is sudden death."
143 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "They brought watermelon and dates for the Prophet (S). He ate of both of them and said, 'These are delightful.'"
149 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "There is no religion for those who comply with created beings while disobeying the Creator."
150 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, "Eat pomegranate seeds along with the white membrane for it cleanses the stomach."

Imam Hasan.text: Imam Al-Hasan ('a) said: Meanness is to avoid thanking the grace.
Imam Al-Hasan ('a) said: He who depends upon God's good option for him will not wish to be in a situation other than that which God opts for him.
Imam Al-Hasan ('a) said: The good that lacks evil is to thank the grace and to tolerate the misfortune.
Imam Al-Hasan ('a) said to a man who had just been cured from a disease: God has mentioned you; therefore, you should mention Him, and has pardoned you; therefore, you should thank Him.
Imam Al-Hasan ('a) said: I do not know anyone who is not foolish in his relation to His Lord.
As someone accused him of enjoying haughtiness, Imam Al-Hasan ('a) said: No, I enjoy honor. God says: Honor belongs to God, His Messenger and the believers. (63:8).
As he was asked about chivalry, Imam Al-Hasan ('a) answered: Chivalry is to cling to the religion, recondition the wealth, and fulfill the duties completely.
Imam Al-Hasan ('a) said: When you meet your friends, you should kiss them on the place of light in the forehead.
Imam Al-Hasan ('a) delivered this sermon after signing the peace treaty with Mu'awiya when the latter said, "Refer to our merits."

Imam Husayn.text: Before Imam Al-Husayn ('a), a man said that favors are worthless if they are done to other than its people. The Imam commented: No, this is accurate. Favors should be like the heavy rain that covers the pious and the sinful.

Imam Al-Husayn ('a) said: Whenever God seizes the power of somebody, He will surely free him from acts of obedience to Him, and whenever He seizes the ability of somebody, He will surely save him from the burdens.
Imam Al-Husayn ('a) said: When God wills to lead a servant to destruction gradually, He bestows upon him with graces and does not favor him show gratitude for these graces.
Imam Al-Husayn said to His son Ali (peace be upon them): O son, beware of wronging him who does not have a supporter except God the Majestic.
As a man asked for the exegesis of God's saying, Proclaim the bounties of your Lord, (93:11). Imam Al-Husayn ('a) said: God orders him to proclaim the religious graces.
Imam Al-Husayn ('a) said: Beware of things for which you apologize. The true believer should not make mistakes and should not apologize. The hypocrite makes mistakes and apologizes every day.
Imam Al-Husayn ('a) said: There are seventy advantages for the greeting. Sixty-nine are given to the one who greets first and one is given to the one who responds to the greeting.
Imam Al-Husayn ('a) said: He who tries to achieve something through acting disobediently to God will miss what he expects and fall in what he fears.

At-Tabari relates the following to Uqba Ibn Al-Aizar: In a place called ThiHasm, Al-Husayn said, after he had praised and thanked God: So then, the matter that you are noticing has befallen us. the world has changed…

Imam al-Sajjad.text: Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: The highest grade of conviction is to satisfy yourself with the detested act of God.
Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: He who honors himself will debase the worldly life.
As he was asked to define the greatest of people, Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: The greatest of people is that who does not see the world as great.

Before Imam As-Sajjad ('a), a man said: "O Allah, make me do without people." The Imam instructed: This is not accurate. People are in the service of each other. You should say: O Allah, make me do without the evil ones.
Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: The richest of people is that who is satisfied with what God has chosen for him.
Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: A deed that accompanies God-fearing will not be decreased. How can an accepted deed be de- creased?
Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: Avoid telling lies, whether they were significant or venial, or in serious or humorous situations, for a man who tells a trivial lie will surely dare to tell a big one.
Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: To see your enemy plunging in acts of disobedience to God because of you is a sufficient victory from God to you.
Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: The whole goodness is to protect yourself (against all that which is unacceptable).

Imam As-Sajjad ('a) said: Asking from people is the humility of life, the remover of pudency, and the debasement of reverence. It is the permanent poverty. Lack of asking from people is the permanent richness.
